sections.title: 一、单项选择
sections.instruction: 从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: He climbed up the ladder (梯子) ________ the wall and went into the classroom ________ the open window.
questions.translation: 他把梯子靠在墙上爬了上去，然后穿过打开的窗户进入了教室。
questions.explanation: ladder against the wall 表示“靠着墙的梯子”，against 意为“倚靠，紧靠”；go through the window 意为“穿过窗户”，through 指从空间内部穿过。故选 against; through。

questions.prompt:
—Mom, ________ I go to the cinema with my classmates this Sunday afternoon?
—Yes, of course you can.
questions.translation:
——妈妈，这周日下午我可以和同学们去电影院吗？
——可以，你当然可以去。
questions.explanation: 根据答语 'Yes, of course you can.' 可知问句是使用情态动词 can 表达请求许可。故选 can。

questions.prompt:
—Tina is really ________. She gets up early to read English every day.
—Yes, she also studies hard at school.
questions.translation:
——蒂娜真的很勤奋。她每天起得很早读英语。
——是的，她在学校也努力学习。
questions.explanation: 根据后文 'gets up early to read English every day' 和 'studies hard at school' 可知 Tina 非常勤奋（hard-working）。故选 hard-working。

questions.prompt: I was told that a new road would be built to ________ my hometown to Zhenjiang.
questions.translation: 我听说将要修建一条新路把我的家乡和镇江连接起来。
questions.explanation: connect... to... 为固定搭配，意为“把……和……连接起来”。故选 connect。

questions.prompt: After the storm, the park was a ________ with fallen leaves and broken branches everywhere.
questions.translation: 暴风雨过后，公园里到处都是落叶和断枝，一片狼藉。
questions.explanation: 根据 'fallen leaves and broken branches everywhere'（到处是落叶和断枝）可知公园一片凌乱（a mess）。故选 mess。

questions.prompt:
—I think my life is so boring.
—Why don't you ________ some hobbies like singing or dancing?
questions.translation:
——我觉得我的生活太无聊了。
——你为什么不培养一些像唱歌或跳舞这样的爱好呢？
questions.explanation: take up a hobby 为固定短语，意为“开始从事/培养一项爱好”。故选 take up。

questions.prompt: Many young designers are using their ________ to make traditional culture more popular.
questions.translation: 许多年轻设计师正在利用他们的创造力让传统文化更受欢迎。
questions.explanation: 设计师设计新颖作品让传统文化流行，利用的是创造力（creativity）。故选 creativity。

questions.prompt:
—Who looked after your sick grandpa in the hospital?
—My father did that ________. He didn't want to trouble others.
questions.translation:
——谁在医院照顾你生病的爷爷？
——我爸爸亲自去照顾的。他不想麻烦别人。
questions.explanation: 根据后句 'He didn't want to trouble others.' 可知是爸爸亲自（in person）照顾。故选 in person。

questions.prompt: The growing popularity of hanfu is a return of traditional clothing, and it also shows our cultural ________ to the world.
questions.translation: 汉服的日益流行是传统服饰的回归，同时也向世界展示了我们的文化自信。
questions.explanation: cultural confidence 为固定搭配，意为“文化自信”。故选 confidence。

questions.prompt:
—Alan, you look angry. What's wrong?
—My brother took away my wallet ________ telling me, and he lost my ________.
questions.translation:
——艾伦，你看起来很生气。怎么了？
——我弟弟没告诉我（不打招呼）就拿走了我的钱包，他失去了我的信任。
questions.explanation: without telling me 意为“没有告诉我”；lose one's trust 意为“失去某人的信任”。故选 without; trust。

sections.title: 二、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
On November 26, 2025, flames spread quickly in a neighborhood of Tai Po, Hong Kong, filling the sky with thick black smoke. A big fire [1] suddenly, putting many people in danger. Firefighters arrived very [2]. Their most important job was to save the people who were caught inside, and they worked very bravely.

But this rescue (救援) was special because the firefighters also worked hard to save the [3]. They looked for pets in the burning buildings. They carried out [4] cats and dogs, and gave them water to drink. An animal rescue team was waiting nearby. [5] the animals were brought out, the team checked their health, gave them first aid, and kept them warm with blankets.

Among these rescues, the most amazing story came later. Firefighters found two cats in one apartment. The cats had been there for several days [6] food after the fire. [7] thought it was a miracle that they were still alive. The firefighters brought them out and the rescue team saved them in time. Finally safe and reunited, the owner and the rescued cats smiled happily together [8] the TV camera.

This event [9] the beautiful friendship between humans and animals. In a dangerous situation, every life is important—both people and animals. The firefighters did not forget our animal friends. Their [10] teaches us that we share the world and should protect each other. It was a day of courage, love, and true care for all living things.

questions.translation: 一场大火突然爆发，让许多人陷入危险之中。
questions.explanation: 火灾、战争或灾害爆发应用 break out（过去式 broke out）。故选 broke out。

questions.translation: 消防员迅速赶到了现场。
questions.explanation: 面对突发大火，消防员快速（quickly）赶赴现场进行救援。故选 quickly。

questions.translation: 但这起救援很特殊，因为消防员还努力去营救动物们。
questions.explanation: 根据后文 'looked for pets... cats and dogs... An animal rescue team' 可知救援还包括动物（animals）。故选 animals。

questions.translation: 他们抱出受惊的猫和狗，并喂给它们水喝。
questions.explanation: 在浓烟烈火中被困的宠物感到极度害怕（scared）。故选 scared。

questions.translation: 当动物被带出来时，救援队为它们检查健康并进行急救……
questions.explanation: 引导时间状语从句，表示“当……的时候”，应用 When。故选 When。

questions.translation: 火灾发生后，这两只猫在没有食物的情况下被困了数天。
questions.explanation: 火灾发生后被困多日没有食物，介词 without 意为“没有”。故选 without。

questions.translation: 每个人都认为它们依然活着是一个奇迹。
questions.explanation: 多日无粮仍能生还，大家都一致认为是个奇迹，应用 Everyone（所有人/每个人）。故选 Everyone。

questions.translation: 主人和被救的猫在电视摄像机前开心地一起微笑了。
questions.explanation: in front of the TV camera 意为“在电视摄像机镜头前”。故选 in front of。

questions.translation: 这次事件展现了人类与动物之间美好的友谊。
questions.explanation: show 意为“展示，展现”。故选 showed。

questions.translation: 他们的善意教导我们，我们共享这个世界，应该互相保护。
questions.explanation: 消防员不顾危险营救小动物体现了善良与爱心（kindness）。故选 kindness。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的心理测验，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
passage: Look at the following quiz (小测验).

[HTML:
Simultaneous Emergency Scenario / 四件事同时发生
A. Boiling Kettle 🫖
Turn off the fire that is heating the kettle on the stove.
B. Ringing Phone ☎️
Answer the ringing telephone on the table.
C. Crying Baby 👶
Calm the baby who is crying aloud in the walker.
D. Chewing Dog 🐕
Stop the dog from chewing destructively on the sofa.
]

Pay attention to what you see in the picture.
Think about what you would do first.
• A: Turn off the fire that is heating the kettle (水壶).
• B: Answer the phone.
• C: Calm the baby who is crying aloud.
• D: Stop the dog from chewing (啃) on the sofa.

Type A: You are a person who puts safety first. You turn off the fire first because you think it is important to protect your home and your family. Also, you do your best to make sure that everything is in order.

Type B: You consider (认为) yourself to be lazy and like to relax at home. It does not bother you too much if you have to wait a bit to feel comfortable. In addition, you enjoy spending time with your friends and family because you also like communication.

Type C: You are responsible (负责的) and able to make important decisions even without the help of others. You do not usually give up on others when they have problems. You will try to help them out as much as you can.

Type D: You do many things on impulse (冲动). You are easily angry at boring things in life. You pay a lot of attention to how you look.

This quiz is just for fun. Don't take it seriously.

questions.prompt: If you do A first, it means ________ according to the material.
questions.translation: 根据材料，如果你先做A，意味着你注重安全。
questions.explanation: 根据 Type A 描述 'You are a person who puts safety first.' 可知先做A的人将安全放在首位（value safety）。故选 you value safety。

questions.prompt: Jack likes spending time with his parents, so he may ________ first according to the material.
questions.translation: 杰克喜欢花时间和父母待在一起，所以根据材料他可能会先接电话。
questions.explanation: 根据 Type B 描述 'In addition, you enjoy spending time with your friends and family because you also like communication.'，喜欢花时间与家人朋友在一起对应选择B项（Answer the phone）。故选 answer the phone。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is True according to the quiz?
options: A person who turns off the fire first can easily get angry.
The quiz is very useful. You must take it seriously.
You pay great attention to your looks if you stop the dog first.
Only students can take the quiz when they are at school.
questions.translation: 根据测验，下列哪一项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据 Type D（制止狗）中的描述 'You pay a lot of attention to how you look.' 可知选项“如果你先制止狗，说明你很注重自己的外表”表述完全符合文意。故选 You pay great attention to your looks if you stop the dog first.。 (A与Type D混淆；B与最后一句 'Don't take it seriously.' 相反；D文中未提及)。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
①This month, the charity Parentkind made a survey among about 6,000 UK parents and found that fewer than half of children under the age of 15 help with chores. The most common chore that children usually do is tidying their bedrooms. Then come making their beds, cleaning around the home and doing the dishes.

②Yet Jason Elsom, the head of Parentkind, believes that children benefit from doing certain housework. "Chores are the first lessons in teamwork, responsibility and self-reliance," he said. Helping out around the house teaches children important life skills. It will help make them feel more independent and confident when they're older.

③Besides, looking after a home should be a team effort. Adults already have lots to do, so children should help them out. Moreover, doing chores together can be fun, especially if they make a game out of it. It also shows children's care for other people.

④However, some people argue that children already have lots of other things they need to do, such as homework, activities and clubs. Doing chores on top of all that could make them feel stressed and tired. And free time is for relaxing, playing, exploring and hanging out with friends, not for doing boring housework. Besides, children might not know how to do the housework as well as adults. It could take them a long time to do it, or they might not do it properly. Some adults might have to do some of the tasks, which would take twice as long. It would just be easier and quicker for the adults to do it themselves instead.

⑤What do you think? Should children help around the home?

questions.prompt: According to the survey, what's the most common chore children do?
questions.translation: 根据这项调查，孩子们最常做的家务是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'The most common chore that children usually do is tidying their bedrooms.' 可知最常见的家务是整理卧室。故选 Tidying their bedrooms.。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "It" in Paragraph 3 refer to?
questions.translation: 第3段中画线的单词“It”指代什么？
questions.explanation: 根据前句 'Moreover, doing chores together can be fun... It also shows children's care for other people.' 可知，It 指代前面提到的“做家务（Doing chores）”。故选 Doing chores.。

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 4 mainly talk about?
options: Advice on how to do chores.
questions.translation: 第4段主要讲了什么？
questions.explanation: 第4段以 'However, some people argue that children already have lots of other things they need to do...' 开头，详细阐述了反对/不赞成孩子做家务的原因（学业压力大、效率低不如大人直接做等）。故选 Reasons for not doing chores.。

questions.translation: 这篇文章的结构是怎样的？
questions.explanation: 文章第①段由调查引出背景；第②、③段从不同角度阐述孩子做家务的益处（属于同一侧的并列支持论点）；第④段转折提出反对观点；第⑤段结尾提问引发思考，总结收束。因此结构图为：顶部①分出两支，左支为并列的②③，右支为④，最后汇入底部的⑤（对应选项B的树状结构图）。故选对应的结构图选项。

sections.title: 五、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
passage:
Have you ever thought about the power of a single piece of paper? Imagine folding it over and over again. Do you think it could reach the moon? This sounds impossible. In real life, paper has thickness and resists (抵抗) bending, so most people can't fold a sheet more than seven or eight times.

However, in the world of theoretical math(理论数学), this ordinary object can achieve amazing heights. A normal paper is very thin, perhaps 0.1 mm. When you fold it once, it becomes twice as thick. After ten folds, it's over 10 centimeters thick. Each fold doubles its thickness. This is called exponential growth(指数增长). It grows much faster than you expect. It's so powerful that after just 42 folds, the paper's thickness would be about 439,804 km, which is more than the distance to the moon!

This thought experiment teaches an important lesson. That is, small repeated actions can lead to great results. For example, if you improve by just 1% every day, after one year you would be about 37 times better than when you started. We often miss this because we often think in a simple, straight-line way, not exponentially, and don't realize how quickly small, <u>consistent</u> efforts, like improving by 1% daily, add up.

Whether it's saving money, learning a skill, or building a good habit, this way of thinking helps unlock your potential(潜能). So, the next time you feel a big goal is too difficult, remember the paper. Every fold counts, and small, continuous efforts can really lead to great achievements.

[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" width="320" height="180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block; margin:12px auto; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:8px; font-family:Times New Roman, serif;"><defs><marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" fill="#1e293b"/></marker></defs><line x1="30" y1="145" x2="30" y2="16" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/><line x1="30" y1="145" x2="265" y2="145" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/><text x="36" y="24" font-size="16" fill="#1e293b">Quantity</text><text x="232" y="164" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e293b">Times</text><path d="M 36 122 L 255 76" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><text x="212" y="96" font-size="15" fill="#1e293b">Linear</text><text x="212" y="114" font-size="15" fill="#1e293b">Growth</text><path d="M 36 136 Q 165 130, 204 14" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><text x="208" y="24" font-size="15" fill="#1e293b">Exponential</text><text x="208" y="42" font-size="15" fill="#1e293b">Growth</text></svg>]

questions.prompt: How does the author start the text?
options: By telling a real story about folding paper.
By asking questions and inviting imagination.
By giving the meaning of exponential growth.
By comparing paper with other thick objects.
questions.translation: 作者是如何开篇引入文章的？
questions.explanation: 第一段连用 'Have you ever thought...?', 'Imagine folding it...', 'Do you think it could reach the moon?' 等问句引发读者思考与想象。故选 By asking questions and inviting imagination.。

questions.prompt: What is the main lesson from the thought experiment?
options: We should think in a straight-line way.
We should improve by 1% every day.
We should fold paper many times.
We should keep small repeated efforts.
questions.translation: 这个思维实验告诉我们的主要道理是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段首句 'That is, small repeated actions can lead to great results.' 以及全文主旨可知，核心道理在于坚持微小且重复的努力能带来巨大的成就。故选 We should keep small repeated efforts.。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "consistent" in paragraph 3 mean?
questions.translation: 第3段中画线的单词“consistent”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: consistent 在此处修饰努力，结合 'like improving by 1% daily' 可知是指“持之以恒的、始终如一的（Maintained all along）”。故选 Maintained all along.。

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the last paragraph?
options: Each paper fold can work well.
Skills and savings can unlock potential.
Small continuous efforts can achieve greatness.
questions.translation: 从最后一段中我们可以学到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段末句 'Every fold counts, and small, continuous efforts can really lead to great achievements.' 可知，持续微小的努力终将成就伟大。故选 Small continuous efforts can achieve greatness.。

sections.title: 六、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
①"AI robots are doing radio calisthenics (广播体操)!" At the closing ceremony (闭幕式) of the 15th National Games, a team of AI robots amazed everyone. They performed the exercises perfectly. This wonderful show is not only a cool performance but also a symbol that AI robots have walked into our daily lives and are changing the way we live and work. AI robots are now working in different fields, bringing surprises everywhere.

②At home, AI robots have become useful helpers. Ms. Li, a working mother, bought a home robot last year. "It cleans the floor every morning, cooks porridge for my son, and even helps him review his math homework when I'm busy," she said.

③In hospitals, AI robots are important helpers to nurses. Some small robots can take temperature, send medicines to patients (病人), and even guide visitors. They can work 24 hours a day without rest to make nurses less tired.

④Schools and communities are also welcoming AI robots. In some primary schools, robot teachers help with English pronunciation practice and science experiments (实验). In communities, cleaning robots sort garbage rightly, and keep an eye on public safety at night. These robots make our living environment cleaner and safer.

⑤AI robots are not here to replace humans. Instead, they help people do heavy work, allowing people to focus on more creative and meaningful things. As technology develops, we can expect more AI robots to make our lives healthier, more comfortable, and more wonderful.

questions.prompt: What made everyone amazed at the 15th National Games closing ceremony?
options: The wonderful radio calisthenics performance by athletes.
AI robots performing radio calisthenics perfectly.
The news of the next National Games host.
questions.translation: 在第15届全运会闭幕式上，是什么让大家惊叹不已？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'a team of AI robots amazed everyone. They performed the exercises perfectly.' 可知是AI机器人完美地做广播体操。故选 AI robots performing radio calisthenics perfectly.。

questions.prompt: What can Ms. Li's home robot NOT do according to the passage?
options: Help her son with his math homework.
questions.translation: 根据文章，李女士的家用机器人不能做什么？
questions.explanation: 第2段中提到机器人可以 'cleans the floor', 'cooks porridge', 'helps him review his math homework'，并未提及开车送她上班（Drive her to work）。故选 Drive her to work.。

questions.prompt: Why are robots helpful in hospitals?
options: Because they can help nurses do much work without rest.
Because they are cheaper than human workers.
Because they can talk with patients for hours.
questions.translation: 为什么机器人在医院很有帮助？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段 'They can work 24 hours a day without rest to make nurses less tired.' 可知，机器人可以24小时不休息地协助护士工作从而减轻其负担。故选 Because they can help nurses do much work without rest.。

questions.prompt: What's the best title for the passage?
options: AI Robots: Replacing Humans in the Future
AI Robots: Being Useful in Factories and Hospitals
AI Robots: Making Our Daily Lives Better
AI Robots: Being Expensive for Common Families
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文从全运会表演引出AI机器人深入家庭、医院、学校和社区等方方面面，使我们的日常生活更加美好舒适。故选 AI Robots: Making Our Daily Lives Better。

sections.title: 七、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从短文后的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有两项为多余选项。
sections.passage:
Where do you like spending your vacation? [1] People call it "reverse (逆向) tourism". Now it's getting popular and it has some advantages (优点).

Well-known tourist attractions (旅游景点) are usually crowded and full of visitors, especially during national holidays. [2] It makes it hard for visitors to have relaxing and enjoyable vacations. But at less well-known tourist attractions, visitors can usually get better travel experiences.

The prices of food and hotel stays are usually high at well-known tourist attractions during holidays. But at less well-known ones, prices are much lower. [3]

Less well-known tourist attractions can bring a feeling of freshness. Visitors might not have visited these places before. Spending vacations there can help people enjoy scenery they haven't seen in the past.

Some visitors just want to find somewhere quiet to have a rest. [4]

The rise of reverse tourism is not a bad thing. It brings more chances to the tourism market. And it can help local people make more money. [5] It is believed that reverse tourism will be even more popular in the near future.
wordbank: It can also help these areas get better.
It also brings much waste to these areas.
They prefer visiting the famous tourist attractions.
This kind of travel form is a good choice for them.
Visitors only move one meter every 10 minutes when travelling.
Spending vacations at less well-known tourist attractions is also a good way to save money.
Some like spending vacations at less well-known tourist attractions instead of well-known ones now.

questions.translation: 现在有些人喜欢在不太知名的旅游景点度假，而不是在知名景点。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着指出 'People call it "reverse tourism".'（人们称之为“逆向旅游”），因此前句应介绍现在有人选择去冷门景点这一现象。故选 "Some like spending vacations at less well-known tourist attractions instead of well-known ones now."。

questions.translation: 游客在旅行时每10分钟只能移动一米。
questions.explanation: 前句提到知名景点在节假日人山人海非常拥挤（crowded），后句提到很难享受轻松的假期，选项描述拥挤时寸步难行非常贴切。故选 "Visitors only move one meter every 10 minutes when travelling."。

questions.translation: 在不太知名的旅游景点度假也是省钱的好方法。
questions.explanation: 本段围绕热门景点物价高昂而冷门景点物价低廉（prices are much lower）展开，因此总结去冷门景点是省钱的好途径。故选 "Spending vacations at less well-known tourist attractions is also a good way to save money."。

questions.translation: 这种旅行形式对他们来说是一个不错的选择。
questions.explanation: 前句提到有些游客只想找个安静的地方休息，冷门景点人少清静，所以这种旅游形式对他们来说是极好的选择。故选 "This kind of travel form is a good choice for them."。

questions.translation: 它还能帮助这些地区变得更好。
questions.explanation: 前句提到帮助当地人赚更多钱（make more money），接着用并列句进一步说明也能促进当地发展变好（help these areas get better）。故选 "It can also help these areas get better."。

sections.title: 八、短文填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，根据语篇内容从选项中选出恰当词汇的正确形式填入空白处。
sections.passage:
Nowadays, more and more people like ordering takeout (外卖). It is one of the [1] (popular) ways of eating among young people. Some might ask: Did people eat takeout food in ancient times?

Maybe you don't think so. [2] (but) in fact, there was takeout even in the Song Dynasty. According [3] (to) history books, Emperor Xiaozong liked to order takeout at night. His servants went around the city and [4] (bring) the food back. Many others, from officials (官员) to [5] (businessman), also used takeout service. The restaurant workers were very [6] (energy). They stood in the street, calling out loudly to draw (吸引) customers. After the customers ordered the dishes, the workers would prepare and send them to their homes. [7] (final), people could comfortably enjoy their favourite dishes at home.

In the famous painting *Along the River During the Qingming Festival* (《清明上河图》), we can see a takeout worker walking with a meal box in [8] (he) hand.

People at that time even made special meal boxes for takeout food. They tried their best [9] (create) warming bowls made of two layers (层). Boiled water could be put between them to keep the food warm. By doing so, people could have hot meals at any time.

So, next time you plan to order takeout, think about this: you [10] (get) more than just a meal. You're going to receive a piece of history that comes to your door, all the way from the Song Dynasty!

questions.translation: 它是年轻人中最受欢迎的就餐方式之一。
questions.explanation: one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词，popular 的最高级为 most popular。故选 most popular。

questions.translation: 但事实上，甚至在宋代就已经有外卖了。
questions.explanation: 与前句 'Maybe you don't think so.' 形成转折关系，句首首字母大写用 But。故选 But。

questions.translation: 据史书记载，宋孝宗喜欢在夜间点外卖。
questions.explanation: according to 为固定介词短语，意为“根据，依据”。故选 to。

questions.translation: 他的仆从们穿梭于全城，把食物带回来。
questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列的过去时谓语动词（went... and brought...），bring 的过去式为 brought。故选 brought。

questions.translation: 许多其他人，从官员到商人，也使用外卖服务。
questions.explanation: 与复数名词 officials 并列，且指代商人这一群体，应用复数形式 businessmen。故选 businessmen。

questions.translation: 餐馆的员工非常精力充沛、充满活力。
questions.explanation: 系动词 were 后面接形容词作表语，energy 的形容词形式是 energetic（精力充沛的）。故选 energetic。

questions.translation: 最终，人们能舒适地在家里享用他们最喜欢的菜肴。
questions.explanation: 修饰整个句子作状语，且位于句首，应用副词 Finally（最终）。故选 Finally。

questions.translation: 我们可以看到一个外卖伙计手里拿着一个餐盒在走。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 hand 作定语，应用形容词性物主代词 his（他的）。故选 his。

questions.translation: 他们尽最大努力制作出由两层构成的保温碗。
questions.explanation: try one's best to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“尽某人最大努力做某事”，后接动词不定式 to create。故选 to create。

questions.translation: 你所得到的不仅仅是一顿饭。
questions.explanation: 与后句 'You're going to receive a piece of history' 呼应，表示当前你正在收到的不仅仅是一餐饭，现在进行时 are getting 表示生动的情境。故选 are getting。

sections.title: 九、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Dear students and parents,

We are excited to invite you to our Education Talk Event in the main school hall of Minghua Middle School. It will take place at 9 a.m. on January 10th. This event is a great opportunity to improve your communication skills.

At this event, we will have many fun workshops. These workshops will give you helpful information about communicating better in your daily life. We want you to feel more comfortable when talking to friends, teachers or even new people you meet.

There will be a special speech by Professor Jones. He will share tips and secrets about how to communicate well with everyone around you. He will also talk about how good communication can help you in school, at home, and in your future career.

When you attend this event, you will learn ways to express your thoughts clearly. You will also discover how to listen carefully to others. Good communication is not only about talking; it is also about understanding what others are saying. This can help you make new friends and solve problems better.

We hope you can join us at the event. If you want to come, please let us know. You can call the school office. We look forward to seeing you there and having a fun and educational time together.

questions.prompt: Where will the Education Talk Event take place?
options: In the main school hall of Minghua Middle School.
questions.translation: 教育讲座活动将在哪里举行？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'in the main school hall of Minghua Middle School' 可知活动在明华中学主校厅举行。故选 In the main school hall of Minghua Middle School.。

questions.prompt: What time will the event start?
questions.translation: 活动将在什么时间开始？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'It will take place at 9 a.m. on January 10th.' 可知活动在1月10日上午9点举行。故选 At 9:00 a.m. on January 10th.。

questions.prompt: Who will give a special speech at the event?
options: The headmaster of Minghua Middle School.
questions.translation: 谁将在活动中发表特别演讲？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段 'There will be a special speech by Professor Jones.' 可知琼斯教授将发表演讲。故选 Professor Jones.。

questions.prompt: What will the speaker talk about in his speech?
options: How to prepare for difficult school exams.
How to communicate well and how good communication helps in life and career.
How to build robots in the school laboratory.
questions.translation: 演讲者将在演讲中谈论什么内容？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段 'He will share tips and secrets about how to communicate well... and how good communication can help you in school, at home, and in your future career.' 可知他将分享良好沟通的方法及其在生活和未来事业中的帮助。故选 How to communicate well and how good communication helps in life and career.。

questions.prompt: How can good communication skills help you in your daily life?
options: By making you speak faster than others.
By helping you pass math tests easily.
By helping you make new friends and solve problems better.
By allowing you to avoid all homework.
questions.translation: 良好的沟通技巧如何在日常生活中帮助你？
questions.explanation: 根据第4段最后一句 'This can help you make new friends and solve problems better.' 可知良好沟通有助于结交新朋友和更好地解决问题。故选 By helping you make new friends and solve problems better.。
